We’ve consolidated over 11 million recipes from 18,000 recipe websites, in 20 languages to create the largest recipe collection ever. This knowledge was fed into an AI system that learnt the intricacies of all ingredients and how they can be mixed together.

All you have to do is build your pantry on the app – and you’re ready to make delicious meals without ever leaving your house!

SuperCook will find you any recipe you need, whether it’s for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or even a midnight snack.

--Easily Add Your Ingredients--
Save time and money with an intelligent pantry. SuperCook’s voice dictation mode allows you to quickly add ingredients to your in-app pantry by simply saying them out loud.

Just open your fridge, click the microphone button, and start listing everything inside. The app will automatically add the ingredients to your pantry for a quick and easy way to find recipes!

--Automatic Recipe Recommendations--
The app will automatically find you recipes to make with what’s in your fridge – so all those lost ingredients in the back of your cupboard now have a place on your table. It’s that simple!

When you run out of an ingredient, simply open the SuperCook app and remove it from your pantry - and all the recipe ideas will adjust accordingly.

--Get Creative in the Kitchen--
SuperCook inspires new ideas and activities in the kitchen for new cooks, busy parents, foodies, and pro chefs alike.

With over 11 million recipes available in 20 different languages, SuperCook promises that you’ll never cook the same thing twice (unless you want to, of course!).

--What's on the menu ?--
The menu page is where you'll find all your recipe ideas. Why is it called menu? Because just like the menu in a restaurant, everything on the menu page is available to you now. SuperCook instantly analyzes 11 million recipes and finds the ones that match your unique ingredients.

Most likely your menu page will contain thousands of recipes, but don't worry, we've broken them down into helpful categories like soups and stews, appetizers and snacks, salads, entrees, desserts and more.

--Reduce food waste--
Most people don't realize how much food they throw away every day — from uneaten leftovers to spoiled produce. SuperCook is one of the best ways to reduce food waste in the home. It finds recipes that use as many of your ingredients as possible, so nothing goes to waste. SuperCook makes food waste prevention fun and easy, just open the menu page on the app and choose a recipe. We help you use what you have, so nothing goes to waste!

name: Brew Meister: Measure & Manage
description:
Brew Meister - Collects results from the digital density meter EasyDens or the digital refractometer SmartRef by Anton Paar.

The EasyDens & SmartRef deliver highly precise results in seconds and allows you to determine the extract content of your beer. In combination with the Brew Meister app, you can monitor the fermentation process of your handcrafted beer and store the measurement results within customizable batches.

The Brew Meister mobile app supports you in the management, visualization and exportation of data.

FEATURES

Brew Meister reports results in the following units:
• Density [g/cm³]
• Specific Gravity current temperature [SG]
• Specific Gravity 20/20 [SG 20/20]
• Specific Gravity 20/04 [SG 20/04]
• Specific Gravity 20/04 [SG 15/15]
• °Plato [°P] (ATC)
• °Brix [°Bx] (ATC)
• Alcohol Content [% ABV]


• Temperature readings are reported in °Celsius [°C] or °Fahrenheit [°F].
• The concentration values shown on your phone are already temperature-corrected, so you need no further calculations and correction tables.
• The EasyDens is adjusted using the app and distilled water.


For density and concentration measurements, you will require an EasyDens by Anton Paar: http://www.easydens.com
For refractive index readings, you will require a SmartRef by Anton Paar: http://www.my-smartref.com


SUPPORT
Contact us at support@easydens.com or support@my-smartref.com

name: Beer Carbonation Calculator
description:
Force carbonating your homemade beverage (e.g.: beer, ciders, sparkling water, sparkling wine) in your keg requires that you set the correct settings in your CO2 regulator.

This App aims to aid homebrewers in this task, by providing a list of common carbonation values, an easy to use calculator and a table of values by pressure and temperature (commonly known as a carbonation chart) where you can visually find your desired setting.

It supports imperial and metric units as well as both carbonation by volume (Volumes) and by weight (g/L).

Please note that carbonation takes time to happen and this App will only tell you what to set in your cylinder regulator, not for how long. I highly suggest that you look up the web for more information on how to force carbonate before attempting to doing so.

Follow your equipment’s instructions and pressure ratings. Use all applicable safety standards.

A BrewBeer traz a você a melhor experiência na fabricação de cervejas artesanais.

O novo aplicativo para máquinas BrewHome Link permite a automação de todas as etapas de controle de tempo e temperatura da brassagem, parte quente do processo de produção de cerveja, sem perder a valiosa interação do cervejeiro artesanal com o processo. A caixa de controle BrewHome Link juntamente com o aplicativo, permite ao usuário executar outras tarefas enquanto o processo está andamento, o usuário é alertado via aplicativo e alarme sonoro local do início e término de cada etapa.

O aplicativo já contempla todos os parâmetros dos kit de receitas da BrewBeer e permite a criação e o armazenamento de novas receitas.

Características principais:

- Controle sua BrewHome Link remotamente via Bluetooth utilizando seu dispositivo móvel como um controle remoto.
- Armazene todas as suas receitas no seu dispositivo móvel
- Todos os controles da placa principal na palma de sua mão
- Configurações de fábrica somente na placa de controle principal
- Avance ou altere qualquer etapa de tempo e temperatura em andamento
- 5 etapas de mostura
- Etapa de fervura manual ou automática
- Etapa de fervura automática com até 4 alerta de adições de lúpulos
- A placa de controle principal funciona de forma autônoma sem a necessidade do aplicativo
- Kit de receitas disponíveis na loja on-line www.brewbeershop.com.br

Nota: A conexão Bluetooth pode ser perdida dependendo da distância e barreiras entre o dispositivo remoto e a placa de controle BrewHome Link. Caso isso ocorra, o BrewHome Link continuará o processo sem o dispositivo remoto. Ao você voltar ao alcance do sinal, o aplicativo irá conectar automaticamente, caso isso não ocorra, reinicialize o dispositivo para reconectar.

name: Partender – Fast Bar Inventory
description:
As featured on Paramount Network's "Bar Rescue" Partender is a patented, subscription-based business tool with a proprietary design that empowers you to:
- Do full, physical bar inventory in just 15 minutes and with up to 99.2% accuracy
- Split up the work across as many users as you'd like on iOS, Android, and even the web
- Generate editable "Smart Orders" based on what you actually went through
- Place, track, and receive those orders online
- Get alerted when prices change
- Get your Usage (for Variance)
- Get your Actual Cost of Goods Sold (COGS for Bev Cost %)
- See what’s trending in your venue such as Top Movers and Dead Stock

And besides saving time and labor, our customers:
1) Reduce Inventory Value On-Hand by 20-40%
2) Reduce Beverage Cost by 6-8%
3) Reduce Cost of Goods Fluctuation by 10%

...all in just 90 days of weekly use after setup.

Here’s what some of them had to say:

"Inventory takes less than 15 minutes now. It used to take 2 hours with 3 people counting, for a total of 6 labor hours."
- Grant S. at Boston Pizza

“It takes us just 15 minutes to do inventory, which we do at least twice a week. We stopped running out of things, and thanks to Partender, we managed to get beverage costs down to 20% in a matter of months."
- Mike W. at Marriott

How? Why?

Because when you count your inventory as accurately and as frequently as you count the cash in your register, less disappears. And the average shrinkage in our industry is 23% because no one's counting how much is there.

So when your inventory is 10-50x more valuable than your cash register, it makes sense to count it as carefully as the till, but that's been impossible until Partender.

So throw out your paper-and-pen and homegrown spreadsheets. Do inventory in minutes - not hours. See what's selling the best/worst, what's dead stock (and needs to get phased out via happy hour promotions), and what's about to run out and get 86'd (so you never miss a sale).

Stop manually typing your inventory into Excel or a glorified web-based spreadsheet. Let Partender streamline all of your inventory, ordering, and accounting operations in just 15 minutes a week.

With Partender, you can also:
- Monitor actual depletions
- See real-time customer insights for your actual customers on a per-product or per-category basis
- Instantly receive your Value On-Hand (like a "Balance Sheet") in wholesale and retail dollars after every inventory
- Optimize your par levels (based on online graphs) to buy more of what's selling the best and less of what's selling the worst
- Clearly understand why your cost of goods is going up (due to Price Change Alerts or due to shrinkage* via our Usage / Variance Report online

*Shrinkage is the loss of inventory due to over-pouring, theft, breakage, spillage, not tracking comps, etc. And there's an average 23% shrinkage in the industry which causes 60-80% of bars and restaurants to fail within 3 years. Or let significant amounts of revenue just walk out the door.

HOW DOES PARTENDER WORK?
Build a virtual "blueprint" of your venue after organizing your bar to split up the work of inventory across Main Bar, Back Bar, Stock Room, etc. Instead of manually writing down your inventory using an arbitrary 10-point scale, cumbersome scales, or expensive hardware, simply tap where the liquor level is on the real image of the bottle and swipe to the next bottle on your shelf. That's it! Our proprietary algorithms are up to 99.2% accurate so you know down to the drop & dollar-value how much each bottle is worth in Retail & Wholesale Dollars ($).

INVENTORY ANYTHING:
In addition to liquor, you can inventory beer, wine, smallwares, kegs, and FOOD! Our database is huge. If there's something on your shelf that's not in our database: take a picture of it, and our proprietary algorithms will do the rest.

ANALYTICS IN THE CLOUD:
Just log into your web dashboard to see COGS, beautiful graphs & trends of what customers are drinking in real-time.

name: My Board Game Collection
description:
What if you could have all the information about your boardgames in one beautiful location?
Not only the data coming from the online database (BoardGameGeek), but also your custom data & play sessions.

What if it could translate the information to any language?
We have systems at our fingertips that allow us to translate to any language in the world. We use those systems to allow you to translate descriptions & comments.

By making use of BoardGameGeek & BoardGameAtlas we are able to give you an enourmous amount of information about your collection and/or about board games you want to check out.

No database is perfect so we created a way for you to add to the existing data.
You can add videos (f.e.: how to play), website urls (f.e.: alternate play rules), images (f.e.: your pictures), your notes, game language, tags, purchase date & purchase price and more.

Finding new boardgames can be very exciting, so we are giving you options to be able to find cool new games.
You can view dynamic lists and you can search the database with various filters. Search filters like player count, age, play time, ...

Choosing a boardgame to play is not always easy, that is why we give you multiple options to filter your collection: name, cooperative play, number of players, playtime, release year, is digital, difficulty, tags or/and a favorite.

Even with all these filters it can be hard to choose, some people just have a lot of very cool games in their collection. For these situations we have added a 'pick random' action to the list.

We are a strong believer in open formats so My Board Game Collection uses an open format for its backup/restore files.

Log your play sessions and keep track of what, when and where you played. You can also log who played and who won and with what score. Never forget.

My Board Game Collection is fully usable in its free form, but creating an app requires a huge amount of time and resources. To be able to support My Board Game Collection going forward we have added ads & a couple of premium features. You can remove the ads and unlock the premium features in 2 ways:
1. FREE: You can watch reward videos that will give you ad free time with the app. This ad free time can also be used to use PREMIUM features.
2. PAID: An single in app purchase is available to remove all ads and unlock all premium features.

PREMIUM Features:
- Remove all ads.
- Search images using our in app search screen.
- Change the limit of 2 score / health / resource tracker to unlimited.
- Enable the 'fast jump' on the bottom of the boardgame list.

Check out our social channels to see what is coming, show your support or tell us about any suggestions you might have.
Also available on other platforms. Check out our social channels for more info.

name: Where Winds Meet
description:
Step into an open-world action-adventure RPG set in ancient China. Uncover the secrets of your own identity as you rise from a humble village wanderer to the sword master of the imperial capital. Learn martial arts and build your reputation as a hero or a bringer of chaos in this free wuxia world.

Jianghu knows no bounds. Play free across PS5, PC, and mobile with full cross-play and cross-progression. No pay-to-win.
Gameplay content is entirely free, with monetization limited to cosmetic items.
In Where Winds Meet, Chinese martial arts meet a seamless open world. Roam vast landscapes, uncover hidden ruins, and descend into layered underground catacombs. Steal techniques from martial sects, wield an arsenal of classic wuxia weaponry, and master over 30 mystic arts – from the flowing balance of Tai Chi to the force of Lion's Roar.
Craft, architecture, astronomy, folk games and performance, medicine and healing – 16 systems come together to form an immersive ancient society.

Adventure Alone or Forge Your Community

Embark on a narrative-driven adventure filled with rich solo gameplay, or team up with up to four friends for seamless co-op experiences.

Join or create a Guild to access group activities: intense guild wars, multiplayer dungeons, and epic raids. Show your skill in competitive duels, or enter a shared, evolving world with thousands of fellow wanderers.

Master Your Way of Wuxia Combat


Tailor your combat – melee, ranged, or stealth. Build a loadout that suits your playstyle. Engage in combat with classic wuxia weapons – sword, spear, dual blades, rope dart, bow, fan, and umbrella. Switch weapons and employ martial arts and mystic skills like Tai Chi to outmaneuver enemies.

Customize Your Jianghu Identity

Customize your character, choose your role, align with factions, and explore unique professions to shape your identity.

Here, freedom is yours, but every action has its weight. Cause chaos, defy the law, and face bounties, pursuit, even time behind bars. Or walk a nobler path: befriend villagers, forge alliances, and grow your reputation as a hero of the Wuxia world. In a world torn by chaos, become the spark that ignites change and forge your legacy!

name: Pancia : Batch Cooking
description:
Préparez des repas équilibrés en un clin d'œil avec Pancia, votre compagnon culinaire ultime ! Notre application intuitive vous permet de planifier facilement vos repas pour plusieurs jours, en suivant les recommandations nutritionnelles et en vous offrant une expérience de cuisine pratique, saine et sans stress.

Planification de repas simplifiée
Dites adieu à la question quotidienne "Qu'est-ce que l'on mange ce soir ?" Pancia vous permet de planifier vos repas en avance, que ce soit pour vous-même ou pour toute votre famille. Indiquez simplement le nombre de jours et les membres de votre famille, et notre application générera un planning alimentaire complet. Fini les tracas de décider quoi cuisiner chaque jour !

Liste de courses optimisée
Une fois votre planning de repas établi, Pancia vous fournit une liste de courses complète et optimisée. Vous y trouverez tous les ingrédients nécessaires pour préparer vos délicieux repas équilibrés. Ne perdez plus de temps à errer dans les rayons du supermarché ou à oublier des ingrédients essentiels. Notre liste de courses vous simplifie la vie et vous fait économiser de l'argent en évitant les achats impulsifs.

Préparation d'ingrédients intelligente
Avec Pancia, la préparation des ingrédients devient un jeu d'enfant. Notre application vous propose des ingrédients qui peuvent être préparés en une seule session de cuisine en utilisant une méthode de batchcooking. Économisez du temps en préparant tous vos ingrédients en une seule fois, que ce soit en les découpant, en les cuisant ou en les portionnant. Vous n'aurez plus qu'à assembler les ingrédients lors de la préparation de chaque repas, pour une expérience culinaire fluide et sans tracas.

Recettes savoureuses et équilibrées
Pancia regorge de recettes savoureuses, adaptées à tous les goûts et tous les régimes alimentaires. Nous nous engageons à vous offrir des repas équilibrés avec une bonne répartition en protéines, glucides et lipides, conformément aux recommandations nutritionnelles de Santé Publique France. Nos recettes sont simples à suivre, avec des ingrédients disponibles dans tous les supermarchés. Même les plus novices en cuisine pourront préparer des plats délicieux et nourrissants en un rien de temps.

Bon pour votre santé et la planète
Chez Pancia, nous croyons en une alimentation saine qui profite à votre santé et à l'environnement. Notre application propose des portions adaptées à votre morphologie et à votre niveau d'activité physique, en complément d'un petit-déjeuner équilibré. Nous favorisons également l'utilisation d'ingrédients de saison, des recettes ayant un faible impact sur l'environnement, et nous encourageons la réduction du gaspillage alimentaire. Avec Pancia, vous pourrez prendre soin de votre bien-être tout en étant respectueux de la planète.

Repas sains et abordables
Nous croyons fermement que manger sainement ne doit pas être synonyme de dépenses excessives. Pancia vous propose des repas équilibrés à 4 euros maximum par personne. Dites adieu aux fast-foods coûteux et aux écarts de votre budget. Nous vous aidons à économiser de l'argent en vous fournissant une liste de courses soigneusement élaborée, évitant les achats superflus et les dépenses inutiles.

Simplifiez votre vie, prenez soin de votre santé et découvrez le plaisir de cuisiner avec Pancia. Téléchargez notre application dès maintenant et commencez à préparer des repas équilibrés en un rien de temps.

name: Recipe Scaler – Portion & Cost
description:
"Only have 240g of flour left?"
"How much should I charge for this cake to make a profit?"

Stop doing mental math in the kitchen. [Recipe Scaler – Portion & Cost] is your professional kitchen assistant and business accountant in one app.

■ Why 'Recipe Scaler'?
Most apps only offer simple servings multiplication. Our app allows you to scale an entire recipe based on a single ingredient's weight and provides professional costing analysis including labor, waste (loss rate), and overheads.

■ Key Features
1. Intelligent Scaling
- Resize based on any ingredient. Enter the amount of one item, and everything else adjusts in perfect proportion.
- Precision measurement with decimal-point accuracy for professional baking.
2. Professional Costing & Pricing
- Instantly calculate cost-per-unit from purchase prices.
- Advanced Analysis: Include Loss Rate(%), Labor Time, and Overheads for a true professional profit report.
- Smart Pricing: Set your target markup and see suggested selling prices immediately.
3. Share without App Install
- Share your scaled recipes via a simple web link.
- Recipients can view and interact with your recipe in their mobile browser without downloading anything!

■ Perfect for:

Convert between units of grams, kilograms, ounces, and pounds. You can even convert to "Pounds and Ounces".

Length Converter:
Convert between units of millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers, inches, feet, yards and miles. You can even convert to "Feet and Inches".

Convert between Joules, Kilojoules, Gram Calories, and Food Calories (Kilocalories)

Time Converter:
Convert between seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, and years.

Temperature Converter:
Convert between units of Fahrenheit, Celsius, and Kelvin.

Gas Mark Reference:

Cooking Temperatures:
Easily look up the USDA recommended cooking temperatures of most dishes such as meats, eggs, and casseroles. You can also look up candy cooking temperatures that tell you the stages of sugar at each temperature range.

Easily share your conversions with others if your device has compatible share action apps such as certain email or text messaging apps.

Notes:

3)Conversions by ingredients are based on USDA values and actual measured values.
4)Always check for proper conversions before using converted recipes.

name: Moodi: emotions & mood tracker
description:
Moodi is a self-help therapy journal with effective psychological exercises and emotion tracker to strengthen your mental health and overcome anxiety & depression, stress, low self-esteem, or other psychological difficulties. Take advantage of this CBT mood diary therapy and help yourself to raise your mood, increase awareness, and enjoy its anti-stress effect.


A psychological diary is a highly effective self-help practice


Psychologists recommend keeping a psychological diary. It can be an emotion tracker, a mood diary a CBT journal, or free-form entries.


As the best self-help practice, it will help you:


  • Better understand yourself, your thoughts, feelings, reactions, and relationships with other people

  • Express emotions and experiences, rather than suppressing them, and ensure better emotional regulation and stress reduction

  • Approach problem-solving and decision-making mindfully

  • Identify sources of stress and anxiety and find ways to cope with them

  • Improve personal development and growth

Self-help practices you will find in this mental health therapy app


Negative situations diary


A Negative Situations Diary is a very effective self-help technique for solving psychological problems. It will help you cope with painful and anxious moments more easily, understand how some events affect your feelings and mood, and strategize your reactions for similar situations in the future.


Make entries about every negative moment, track your thoughts, mark emotions, and select a cognitive distortion. With this therapy journal, you can better understand yourself, your behavior, and your feelings associated with a specific event. Help yourself to free your mind from negativity, and feel much better. By changing your approach to resolving negative situations, your reaction to them will also change.


Positive moments diary


In the Positive Moments Diary (Gratitude Journal), you can write down all your positive events, good emotions, and gratitude. It helps you pay attention to the pleasant moments and, thus, reduce stress and other negative feelings.


Everything that causes positive emotions truly matters. So, use these positive emotions for self-help mindfully. Whether you had a significant event or something fleeting, write it down and mark the emotions you experienced. And motivate yourself.


Morning diary


With the Morning Diary, you can help yourself set up for the day ahead and free your mind from needless worries, irrational anxieties, and negativity. By practicing this morning diary and mood tracker, you will notice how your energy, motivation, awareness, and creativity rise.


Write down your emotions, feelings, experiences, plans, tasks, goals, and desires every day, immediately after you wake up. Write down everything that seems important to you at that moment.


Evening diary


An Evening Diary is an effective self-help practice. With it, you can track your emotions, feelings, and thoughts at the end of the day, right before going to bed. With this mental health tracker, you can analyze your day and get rid of unfounded worries, stress and tension, anxiety & depression. All this helps you relax, sleep better, and recover.


Write down your events and impressions of the past day. Describe your emotions, feelings, self-esteem, and physical condition in detail. Write down the lesson you learn from this day. Don't try to write it correctly, just be honest and record things you believe to be important for you at that moment.


Download Moodi, a CBT therapy journal and mental health tracker. Put one of the most effective self-help practices on your service. Trace and analyze your negative situations and positive moments, and keep a morning journal and evening mood diary. Learn to save and cherish positive feelings and get rid of anxiety & depression.

name: KnowDrugs Drug Checking
description:
KnowDrugs is the easiest way to lookup drug testing results, pill warnings and drug alerts and provides you with drug info about more than 200 drugs, along with advice on harm reduction and safer use. Taking drugs always involves risks - however, if you do decide to take drugs, KnowDrugs can help you to take appropriate measures to reduce potential harms.

DRUG INFORMATION & EDUCATION

Check the profiles of more than 200 drugs for educational purposes: Stimulants like MDMA and Amphetamine, depressants such as Alcohol and Benzodiazepines or psychedelics like 2C-B, LSD and DMT.

KnowDrugs provides you with drug education harm reduction advice, focusing on MDMA / Molly / Ecstasy and other psychoactive substances. Knowing about the wanted and unwanted effects of drugs, their duration, interactions and risks helps you to make more informed decisions, reduce risks and reflect upon your drug habits and consumption behaviour.

DRUG CHECKING, PILL WARNINGS & DRUG ALERTS

Search for drug name, substance or location, to find drug alerts from nearby and learn about their ingredients and dosage strength to avoid overdose and particularly dangerous cuts (e.g. PMA).

Drug checking or pill testing is a way to reduce the harm from drug consumption by allowing users to find out the content and purity of substances that they intend to consume. This empowers users to make safer choices: to avoid more dangerous substances and combination and to use smaller quantities.

If you don't have access to professional drug testing services, looking up recent drug testing results can still help you make a more informed decision about your consumption.

HARM REDUCTION & RESPONSIBLE DRUG USE

Harm reduction aims to minimize the harms associated with recreational substance use. The harm reduction approach follows from the idea that substance use is a high-risk activity that innately entails the possibility of injury, addiction, and death. Therefore, the best strategy one can employ (outside of avoiding use entirely) is to take appropriate measures to mitigate its potential harms.

KnowDrugs highlights the harm-potential of more than 200 substances and demonstrates strategies on how to reduce the harms associated with the consumption of drugs.

KNOWDRUGS CAN ALSO HELP YOU TO:

- learn how to spot and react in case of an emergency, take care of someone experiencing a bad trip at a party or festival
- find a free and confidential counselling service which accepts you and your personal choices, and helps you develop the right strategies and competencies if you want to change something about your consumption behaviour.

» How it works:
1. Set up a habit
2. Tell HabitBull how you went for a day
3. Watch your daily streak increase

Habits are no more than routines which you perform subconsciously. To build one - train yourself. To break one, find another one which is similar, yet different and nicer, and repeat it until it sticks.

To assist you with this HabitBull lets you set reminders for each habit and displays them on days when you need to be successful. This is especially useful if you have a to do list with repeating tasks or if you want to be reminded to do the same thing every day. It can also be used as a calendar planning tool or checklist, but also as a very effective repeating reminder (e.g. to drink water every 2 hours).

HabitBull does feel a little like a game in which you compete with yourself. The task is to get a long streak for the habit you are working on by covering your goals. The longer the better. It takes a couple of months to fully build a new routine, so don't give up - it takes time and if you are consistent it will work; even if it takes a few attempts.

There are many things which you may want to improve. HabitBull can be used as a planner in building habits like taking your pills regularly, exercise, or keep to a diet. It can also be used as a helper for people suffering from memory problems. As for your vices, HabitBull can be a useful goal tracking tool, or a smart notebook, to assist you while breaking bad habits like nail-biting, drinking alcohol and even improving your dating skills.
It is entirely up to you, really. But why not give it a try and have a convenient helper on the go?

3. Watch your heatmap grow as daily streaks and weekly streaks build over weeks and months

Start using your visual daily habit tracker today, one pixel at a time.

name: STRIK - Streak Tracker
description:
STRIK is the streak tracker built on real habit science. Your body doesn't lose a habit after 1-2 days off - so why should your streak? 🏆

Build lasting streaks for reading, exercising, meditating, or any habit you want to develop. This streak tracker understands how habits actually work.

✅ Visualize all your streaks at a glance

✅ Realistic approach to building lasting habits
✅ Minimalist design that stays out of your way

━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔥 FREEZE SYSTEM - BASED ON HABIT SCIENCE

Here's the truth: Missing 1-2 days doesn't break your habit adaptation. Your body and brain retain the habit for short breaks.

STRIK gives you Freezes at 7 days and 21 days. Use a Freeze when life happens - your streak stays alive because your habit adaptation is still intact.

The only streak tracker that reflects how habits actually form in your body and mind.

* Cross-Device Accessibility - The app can be logged into on multiple devices (Android, iOS, & web) and will keep the data synchronized. Upon making any changes in the app, the updated data will be visible on all devices. Auto synchronization makes Foreceipt a receipt tracker app for both a family or a business.

name: Product Management - CraftUp
description:
CraftUp is the product management learning app for product managers, aspiring PMs, founders, designers and developers who want to build better products. It helps you learn product management step by step with short, focused daily lessons you can actually apply in your work and side projects.

If you want to start a product management career, move from junior to mid or senior product manager, or simply make smarter product decisions as a founder, CraftUp gives you a clear, structured path. You learn modern product management, not random tips or outdated theory.

CraftUp is built around real product work. Each lesson focuses on one concrete product management decision: understanding a user problem, validating an idea, designing an MVP, planning a simple experiment, running user interviews, defining product metrics, or deciding what to ship next. You do not just read about product management, you practice product thinking every day.

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

With CraftUp you will learn core product management skills, including:

How to find real problems worth solving using user research

How to validate ideas with interviews, surveys and simple experiments

How to design and build MVPs that test the right product assumptions

How to get your first users and grow from zero with limited time and budget

How to use feedback, data and metrics to improve your product

How to understand product market fit and avoid false signals

How to prioritize a roadmap when everything feels important

How to make better product decisions with scarce resources

How to think and communicate like a product manager or founder

This is practical product management training you can use if you are preparing for a PM role, already working as a product manager, or building your own startup.

WHO CRAFTUP IS FOR

CraftUp is designed for:

People starting from zero who want a clear way to learn product management

Aspiring product managers preparing for their first PM job or interview

Junior product managers who want to grow faster and build confidence

Founders and indie hackers who need product management skills to ship smarter

Designers and developers who want to understand product decisions, not just tickets

Professionals in other fields who want to learn product thinking and turn ideas into products

HOW IT WORKS

CraftUp breaks product management into small, guided steps. Lessons are short, structured and focused on one topic at a time. You can complete a lesson in a few minutes, but over time you build deep understanding of how real product management works.

You learn how to frame user problems, write simple hypotheses, design experiments, pick metrics that matter, and make tradeoffs. Many lessons use examples from real products and real product managers so you see how product thinking works in practice, not in theory.

WHY CRAFTUP IS DIFFERENT

CraftUp is not another generic business course or a playlist of long video lectures. It is a dedicated product management learning environment. The content is focused only on product management and product thinking. No fluff, no motivational noise, just clear explanations and concrete actions.

The experience is calm and intentional. You will not find growth hacking tricks or pressure to hustle more. Instead, CraftUp helps you build a consistent learning habit so you actually stick with product management over weeks and months. You get just enough structure to keep moving forward without feeling overwhelmed.

CraftUp is your companion in the messy but rewarding process of learning product management and turning ideas into real products. Whether you want to become a product manager, level up in your current role, or build your own product as a founder, CraftUp gives you the product management skills, mindset and practice you need.

Learn product management. Build better products.

HVAC Airflow CFM Calculator helps HVAC technicians, engineers, and contractors calculate cubic feet per minute (CFM) airflow with four methods for cross-checking and verification. This air conditioning calculator eliminates guesswork in ductwork design and system diagnostics.

CALCULATION METHODS:
Temperature Delta Method — CFM from BTU load and supply/return temperature difference
Duct Velocity Method — CFM from duct size (round or rectangular) and air velocity (FPM)
Sensible Heat Method — CFM from sensible cooling/heating capacity and temperature delta
Total Heat Method — CFM from total heat load and enthalpy difference

CORE FEATURES:
Round & Rectangular Duct Support — Both duct shapes in velocity calculations
Cross-Check Verification — Use multiple CFM methods to validate calculations
Instant Results — Airflow, velocity, and duct area displayed in real-time
100% Offline Operation — No internet connection required for field calculations
English & Spanish Support — Bilingual interface for diverse crews

• Unlimited saved calculation history

name: Unique: ADHD Planner & Journal
description:
Unique is an ADHD journal & planner that helps you organize tasks, build habits, and track mood - without shame or overwhelm. Use a daily journal for journaling, a habit tracker for routines, a task planner for priorities, and a mood tracker to understand patterns. You also get ADHD-friendly CBT courses and AI guided meditations to support focus, emotional balance, and follow-through.

1. ADHD journal & journaling
Open the journal, write one short line, and move on. Your journal can be messy, tiny, or detailed - journaling counts even when it’s one sentence. Use the journal to capture what’s happening in your ADHD day: distraction, procrastination, stress, motivation, energy, and wins. When your brain feels loud, journaling helps you pause and reset.

2. Mood tracker that connects to your journal
Do a quick mood check-in, then add a note in your journal. Your mood tracker makes it easy to track mood, stress, and energy in seconds. Over time, the mood tracker helps you spot patterns: how sleep, routines, habits, and tasks affect your mood. The journal + mood tracker combo turns “I feel weird” into clear signals you can use.

3. Planner, task planner & task tracker for real life
Unique is a planner built for ADHD: flexible, simple, and forgiving. Use the task planner to pick 1–3 priorities, break big tasks into small steps, and adjust when plans change. Track tasks with a task tracker mindset: what’s next, what’s done, what can wait. Your planner helps you plan today and review later—without turning planning into another task.

4. Habit tracker, habits, routines & consistency
Build habits gently with a habit tracker that supports the ADHD brain. Add one habit, set a reminder, and track progress. Turn habits into routines you can repeat daily or weekly. If you miss a day, your habit tracker helps you restart. The goal is steady habits, realistic routines, and less decision fatigue.

5. CBT courses for ADHD skills (not theory)
Unique includes CBT courses designed for ADHD challenges: procrastination loops, all-or-nothing thinking, emotional overwhelm, and self-talk. Each CBT course is practical and short, so you can apply it immediately in your planner, journal, habit tracker, and mood tracker.

6. AI guided meditations for focus & calm
Use AI guided meditations when you need a reset: before work, after stress, or during low-focus moments. Meditations are built to support attention, relaxation, and emotional regulation.

What you can do in Unique:
• ADHD journal for daily journaling
• Mood tracker (mood check-ins + notes)
• Planner & task planner for priorities
• Task tracker approach to follow-through
• Habit tracker for habits & routines
• CBT courses for ADHD tools
• AI guided meditations for calm & focus

Made for ADHD brains
Unique is for people who want an ADHD app that combines journal, planner, habit tracker, task planning, and mood tracking in one place. Track mood, plan tasks, build habits, and learn with CBT courses—one small step at a time.

name: ADHD Organizer: Llama Life
description:
Llama Life is a daily task planner and organizer, designed to help you focus on ONE task at a time - so you're not just making lists, you're actually getting THROUGH them!

Llama Life let’s you set a countdown timer for *every* task. This concept is called ‘timeboxing’, and the idea is to create a (positive) constraint around the time we have to do something. The goal is to try and give a task 100% of our attention, until the timer runs out. This helps to increase focus, and gives us the mental space to think about ONE thing at a time.

Llama Life also let’s you know your total List Time, and the estimated finishing time, so you can be more aware of time passing, and plan your day.

We also love celebrating the wins, big or small, so very importantly, you get confetti (woo hoo!) when you finish a task. You can also personalize with color and emoji to get lots of variety and keep things fun and fresh!

Llama Life offers a 7-day free trial, with a Monthly or Annual subscription.

I'm so glad you’re here, and are rooting for your success!

All the best,
Marie
Founder, Llama Life

description:
Bring structure to your workflow by utilising time blocking technique.


Time blocking is an effective strategy for using time wisely and achieving greater results. Blocking out time for specific activities allows you to focus on one task at a time, limit distractions and procrastination.


It's really simple to use:


1. Define your tasks at hand, make a task list.

2. Define a block of time during which you will eliminate all distractions and give all your focus to your tasks. Start the timer and work.

3. Take frequent breaks. Regular breaks are conducive to greater productivity and concentration. During these breaks take a breath of fresh air, do some push-ups, stretch or anything else that helps you to restore your power. Your body will thank you.

4. Repeat this work/break cycle and take a longer breaks when you feel you need to.

name: Google Fit: Activity Tracking
description:
Get to a healthier and more active life with the new Google Fit!

It's hard to know how much or what kind of activity you need to stay healthy. That's why Google Fit collaborated with the World Health Organization (WHO) and the American Heart Association (AHA) to bring you Heart Points, an activity goal that can help improve your health.

Activities that get your heart pumping harder have tremendous health benefits for your heart and mind. You'll earn one Heart Point for each minute of moderate activity like picking up the pace when walking your dog, and double points for more intense activities like running. It takes just 30-minutes of brisk walking five days a week to reach the AHA and WHO's recommended amount of physical activity shown to reduce the risk of heart disease, improve sleep, and increase overall mental wellbeing.

Google Fit will also help you:

TRACK YOUR WORKOUTS FROM YOUR PHONE OR WATCH
Get instant insights when you exercise and see real-time stats for your runs, walks, and bike rides. Fit will use your Android phone's sensors or Wear OS by Google smartwatch's heart rate sensors to record your speed, pace, route, and more.

MONITOR YOUR GOALS
See your daily progress on your Heart Points and Steps goal. Meeting your goals all the time? Easily adjust your goals to keep challenging yourself to achieve a healthy heart and mind.

MAKE ALL YOUR MOVEMENT COUNT
If you walk, run, or bike throughout the day, your Android phone or Wear OS by Google smartwatch will automatically detect and add your activities to your Google Fit journal to ensure you get credit for every move. Want extra credit? Turn up the tempo on your walks by starting a paced walking workout and stepping to the beat. Enjoy a different type of workout? Select it from a list of activities like pilates, rowing, or spinning, and Google Fit will track all the Heart Points you earn.

CONNECT WITH YOUR FAVORITE APPS AND DEVICES
Fit can show you info from many of your favorite apps and devices to give you a holistic view of your health, so you'll never lose track of your progress. These include Lifesum, Wear OS by Google, Nike+, Runkeeper, Strava, MyFitnessPal, Basis, Sleep as Android, Withings, Xiaomi Mi bands, and more.

CHECK IN AT ANYTIME, FROM ANYWHERE
See a snapshot of your activity history across Fit and your integrated apps in the redesigned journal. Or, get the full picture in browse, where you can find all of your health and wellness data.

KEEP A FINGER ON THE PULSE OF YOUR HEALTH
Breathing is one of the simplest ways to reduce tension and relieve stress. With Fit, checking in with your breath is easy—all you need is your phone camera. As well as your respiratory rate, you can measure your heart rate to get a better understanding of your body’s wellbeing.

VIEW YOUR DAY'S STATS AT A GLANCE
Add a widget to the home screen of your Android phone or set up a tile and complication on your Wear OS by Google smartwatch.

Learn more about Google Fit and see a list of supported apps at: www.google.com/fit

Embody uses gentle somatic movement, not meditation or breathwork.

Most practices are 5–10 minutes.

Embody is somatic practices and nervous system support. Somatic exercises are gentle, intentional movements to release stress and tension, and improve the mind-body connection. These movements shift the body out of “fight or flight” mode and rewire the nervous system to relax.

Many users report feeling calmer and sleeping better after a few days of daily exercises.

Yes, prenatal modifications and pelvic floor exercises are included.

During a release, you may notice sensations like warmth, softening, or emotional expression such as sighing, yawning, or tears. Afterward, the body often feels lighter, more relaxed, and less tense.

name: Accu​Battery
description:
Accu​Battery displays battery usage information, and measures battery capacity (mAh) based on science.
 
❤ BATTERY HEALTH
 
Batteries have a limited lifespan. Every time you charge your device, it wears out the battery, lowering its total capacity.

- Use our charge alarm to remind you to unplug your charger.
- Discover how much battery wear was endured during your charge session.
 
📊 BATTERY USE
 
Accu​Battery measures the actual battery usage using information from the battery charge controller. Battery usage per app is determined by combining these measurements with information on which app is in the foreground. Android calculates battery usage using pre-baked profiles that device manufacturers provide, like how much power the CPU uses. In practice however, these numbers tend to be highly inaccurate.
 
- Monitor how much battery your device is using
- Know how long you can use your device when it’s active or in standby mode
- Find out how much power each app uses.
- Check how often your device gets woken up from deep sleep.
 
🔌 CHARGE SPEED
 
Use Accu​Battery to find the fastest charger and USB cable for your device. Measure the charging current (in mA) to find out!
 
- Check how fast your device is charging when the screen is on or off.
- Know how long it takes to charge your phone and when it’s finished.
 
HIGHLIGHTS
 
- Measure real battery capacity (in mAh).
- See how much wear your battery sustains with each charge session.
- Look up the discharge speed and battery consumption per app.
- Remaining charge time - know how long it takes before your battery is charged.
- Remaining use time - know when you will run out of battery.
- Screen on or screen off estimations.
- Check the percentage of deep sleep, when the device is in standby mode.
- Ongoing notification for real time battery statistics at a glance.
 
🏆 PRO FEATURES
 
- Use Dark and AMOLED black themes to save energy.
- Access to historical sessions older than 1 day.
- Detailed battery statistics in notification.
- No ads
 
We're a small, independent app developer with a focus on quality and passion for battery statistics. AccuBattery doesn’t require access to privacy-sensitive information and doesn't make false claims. If you like the way we work, support us by upgrading to the Pro version.

name: Extrovert or Introvert Test
description:
This test measures the personality trait of extraversion.

Personality traits are relatively stable over time, but they can and often do gradually change as you age.

People who are more extraverted tend to feel energized by social interactions, enjoy meeting and socializing with people, and are often the center of attention. They are often perceived as outgoing, social, full of energy, enthusiastic, and action-oriented.

People who are more introverted tend to feel drained by social interactions, prefer a good amount of solitude, and dislike small talk. They are often perceived as quiet, low-key, and deliberate. They need less stimulation and more time alone than extraverts.

name: Introvert - Be Social
description:
Embracing your inner extrovert might feel like stepping into uncharted territory, but fear not! Becoming more social is an exciting journey that begins with simple steps, gradually leading to newfound confidence and sociability.

Start by taking baby steps into the world of social interactions. Begin with small talk; strike up a conversation with a friendly neighbor, a co-worker, or someone waiting in line. Practice active listening - it's an art that helps you connect more deeply with others.

Challenge yourself to attend social gatherings or events. It might feel daunting at first, but remember, each experience is a chance to grow. Push your comfort zone a little each time. Maybe set a goal to attend one social event a week, or even a month, to start with.

Join clubs or groups that align with your interests. Whether it's a book club, a hiking group, or a cooking class, being around like-minded individuals can make socializing feel more natural and enjoyable.

Practice positive self-talk. Encourage yourself along the way. Acknowledge your progress and celebrate the little victories. Remember, Rome wasn’t built in a day, and neither is the confident extrovert version of yourself!

Lastly, be patient and kind to yourself. Transforming into a more social butterfly takes time. Rome wasn’t built in a day, and neither will your social prowess. Each step you take, no matter how small, is a stride toward a more confident and outgoing you.

So, get ready to spread your wings and dive into the wonderful world of social interactions. You've got this!

name: Diem: Big Group Chat Energy
description:
AI Search, Community Chats

Welcome to Diem! We’re building your new front door to the internet.

Diem is a search-engine-meets-social-network designed first for girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks. You can search the internet with Diem AI and find answers to anything life throws at you. “How do I get over a friend breakup? What’s the best way to negotiate salary? My boyfriend follows models on Instagram—is that a red flag?” Diem is here to help.

Our platform is also full of novel, collective knowledge from people all over the world. You can socialize your search to start conversations, discover a network of communities, connect over shared experiences and browse trending topics.

Joining Diem means showing up with no judgment and immersing yourself in the candid, funny, authentic, important, supportive, outrageous, honest, and wholesome questions of other Diemers, which span everything from birth control to friendship, sexuality to pop culture, parenting to relationships, money to reproductive health, career to books, and so much more. Diem feels more like searching for answers in the girls’ bathroom than spiraling alone on the internet.

Here’s what you can find in the app today:

Diem AI-powered search

Ask Diem AI, our AI-powered search tool, your questions! Our search engine is designed to be less bias than other models. You can think of Diem AI as your most knowledgeable Virgo “big sister” who lives in your back pocket. Diem AI draws from across the internet and the collective wisdom of Diemers to generate you a speedy answer. When you ask Diem AI you’ll receive a short summary answer, community sources (previous, related conversations in Diem), community spaces, web pages, Reddit threads and TikTok videos. You can dive in to these search results OR you can post your search to the community feed to get real-time feedback from people who’ve been there.

Diem AI Lenses

You can now ask questions of leading experts and your fave creators in Diem. Ask their Lens anything and your search result will feature their opinions & content from across the internet.

Discover thousands of authentic conversations

From awkward sex questions to wholesome big sisterly advice or navigating life’s highs and lows, Diem is full of the collective knowledge of girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks in over 100 countries.There’s no judgment here and you’ll feel that very quickly.

Post anonymously or under a pseudonym

We think of the anonymous feature as a confidence booster. Sometimes posting ‘taboo’ questions or personal stories publicly can be nerve-wracking, so this feature is designed to make you feel more comfortable while getting the advice you need.

Community Spaces

Community Spaces are micro communities that are also discoverable when related questions are searched via Diem AI. A few currently live: Am I wrong?, Big Sis Advice (BSA) and Is this Normal…? (ITN) We’re still early in building out Spaces and you can request additional Spaces or host your own.

Creating Posts

If you have a longer story, recommendation or advice to offer you can click the + button on your Discover feed and type out all your stories or wisdom. These posts will be discovered via the search engine and in Diemer’s discovery feeds.

Upvoting & Bookmarking

See a post or response you want to save for later or give some love to, click to bookmark, “heart” or upvote it!

Safety & Privacy First

Safety & moderation are our top priority at Diem. See something, say something! We have distributed moderation—if you report something, we review it, ensuring there’s no violation of the community culture. We also take your privacy very seriously—whatever you search is your business.

We’re still early in our journey to build Diem into your new ‘front door’ to the internet, if you have any problems or ideas for the app, get support at help@askdiem.com.

Happy Dieming!

Privacy Policy: https://www.askdiem.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.askdiem.com/terms-of-service
